# Lonell's Soul Food Cuisine

Lonell's Soul Food Cuisine is an authentic soul food restaurant with live jazz, karaoke, and Sunday Gospel Brunch in South Los Angeles. Located at 8501 S Vermont Ave in the Vermont Knolls neighborhood. Proudly Black-owned and family-owned. "A Place of Love."
